releases.summary: Patch release for testing the fixed Doki update restart flow.
changes: Bumps Doki to 1.2.5 so installations on 1.2.4 can perform a real stable-tag update.
Keeps updater, restart, and migration behavior unchanged from 1.2.4.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
operatorNotes: Use this release to test the fixed helper restart path from a 1.2.4 installation.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Fixes helper-initiated Compose restarts by preserving host repo paths and the active Compose project.
changes: Adds DOKI_HOST_ROOT so update-helper restarts use host filesystem paths for Compose bind mounts.
Passes DOKI_HOST_ROOT and the active Compose project into helper-initiated docker compose stop/start commands.
Adds an explicit default Compose project name so helper-side Compose calls do not inherit the /workspace directory name.
Discovers the active Compose project from running Doki container labels when it is not configured explicitly.
Prevents updated services from being recreated with container-local /workspace bind paths or a separate workspace project.
Keeps failed-restart recovery active until the core services actually start successfully.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
operatorNotes: This release requires rebuilding the update-helper image and restarting core services.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Makes update-helper Git safety self-configuring at container startup.
changes: Adds an update-helper container entrypoint that marks the mounted Doki checkout as a safe Git directory.
Keeps per-command safe.directory handling as a second layer of protection.
Prevents normal installs from requiring any manual Git config command before checking for updates.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
operatorNotes: This release requires rebuilding the update-helper image so the entrypoint is installed.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Fixes updater Git safety handling for Docker-mounted workspaces.
changes: Passes Git's safe.directory option for every update-helper Git command.
Prevents Docker-mounted Doki checkouts from failing with Git dubious ownership errors.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
operatorNotes: This release fixes the update-helper on fresh installs and after the helper image is rebuilt.
Installations already on 1.2.0 may need to run the one-time safe.directory command in the helper container before fetching this release.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Patch release for exercising the Doki stable updater flow.
changes: Bumps Doki to 1.2.1 so installations on 1.2.0 can perform a real stable-tag update.
Keeps database schema unchanged at version 17.
Declares no destructive changes.
operatorNotes: Use this release to verify check, migration dry-run, backup, checkout, and restart stages from the Updates page.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Adds the Doki Updates admin surface and host-side stable release updater.
changes: Adds a super-admin Doki Updates page that opens the update helper with a short-lived token.
Adds a localhost-only update-helper service for stable tag checks, Doki health, migration dry-runs, and apply progress.
Restricts updater discovery to stable semantic version tags such as v1.2.0.
Blocks updates when managed files have local changes.
Runs migration dry-runs against a copied SQLite database before applying updates.
Creates a live database backup before applying an update.
Keeps updater token/state files and SQLite WAL sidecars out of source control.
operatorNotes: Only super-admins can open the Doki Updates page.
The update-helper service is exposed on 127.0.0.1:8100 by default.
This release adds a new Compose service, so rebuild/restart the stack after installing it.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Adds the Logger core app and improves first-run setup/start ergonomics.

databaseMigrations.summary: Logger app creates its own tables on first use.

changes: Adds Logger as a core installed app for viewing configured log files across Doki targets.
Runs setup inside the php-app container so host PHP extensions no longer block setup.
Improves start.sh and setup.sh Docker/Compose checks and startup guidance.
Refreshes README setup order to start Doki before running setup.
operatorNotes: Run ./setup.sh after ./start.sh to refresh runtime state and health checks.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Initial Doki release baseline from main.
changes: Establishes the first release baseline for Doki updates.
Includes Doki admin, apps, workflows, sources, onboarding, and schema version 17.
operatorNotes: Installs without release metadata should be treated as 1.0.0 by the updater.
